{{Quote|Threepio, it is you! Did they get the ship? Did anyone escape?''"<br />"''I'm afraid I don't know, sir. I think they only abducted droids.|Mungo Baobab and C-3PO|<ref name="TGH" />}}
The '''''Argo Moon''''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]], commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cag (Human)|Cag]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While en route to [[Biitu]] to deliver the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to [[Mungo Baobab]], the ''Argo Moon'' was boarded by [[sludgegulper]] droids working for the [[Great Heep]], an [[Abominor]] who had formed an alliance with the Empire to establish a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on Biitu. The crew was incapacitated and the droids were taken captive.

==Description==
The ''Argo Moon'' had a curved [[Hull/Legends|hull]], round at the front and narrowing toward the aft, giving it a teardrop shape from the side. A raised ridge ran down the center of the hull on the top of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The engines were located at the rear of the ship, and it was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to allow it to travel at [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="TGH" /> The logo of the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]], a family crest showing two [[rainbow comet]]s,<ref name="CSWE" /> was located on the dorsal ridge, and was also displayed inside the vessel. The [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] had a crew of two, and seating for at least one passenger. The crew was joined by at least two [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]].<ref name="TGH" />

==History==
[[File:ArgoMoonAttacked-TGH.png|thumb|left|220px|The ''Argo Moon'' is attacked by sludgegulpers.]]
The ''Argo Moon'' served as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in the Baobab Merchant Fleet during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TGH" /> under the command of its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cag (Human)|Cag]].<ref name="CSWE-Cag" /> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="15BBY">"[[Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]" in [[Polyhedron 170|''Polyhedron'' 170]] states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> the ship traveled to [[Biitu]] to deliver several items, including the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], to [[Mungo Baobab]], who was attempting to establish a trading post there. The ship left [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and approached Biitu, unaware that the Empire had established a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TGH" /> under the command of the giant [[Abominor]] droid, the [[Great Heep]].<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

As the ''Argo Moon'' was preparing to land on the planet, it came under attack from another vessel, which launched dozens of [[sludgegulper]] droids toward it. The droids attached to the ''Argo Moon'' and proceeded to tear through the hull, piercing a hole into the cockpit, through which they sprayed a powerful sleeping gas. Cag was unable to reverse the cabin pressure in time and he, along with his co-pilot, was rendered unconscious. The sludgegulpers continued to break through the hull, and abducted all the droids aboard before returning to their vessel with the captives. The ''Argo Moon'' was left in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] while the stolen droids were taken to serve in the Great Heep's mining operation below.<ref name="TGH" />

The effects of the sleeping gas wore off some days later and Cag contacted Baobab to check on the situation on Biitu. By this point Baobab had successfully halted the Imperial mining operation and the ''Argo Moon'' was finally able to land.<ref name="TGH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Argo Moon'' was created for the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] animated series, making its only appearance in the TV special ''[[The Great Heep]]'', written by [[Ben Burtt]]<ref name="TGH" /> and first broadcast on [[June 7]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider32">{{InsiderCite|32|Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television|''Caravan of Courage'': ''Star Wars'' on Television}}</ref> The ship was not identified in ''The Great Heep''<ref name="TGH" /> and went unnamed until its entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE" />
